Company Introduction
Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.
We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”
Role Overview
The Customer-Centric Planning team is looking for a Senior Data Analyst with an engineering mindset. You will not only be a user of data but also a builder of data infrastructure. This position highly integrates Data Analysis and Analytics Engineering. You will be responsible for maintaining Airflow ETL processes from multiple internal data sources such as Zendesk, WMS (Warehouse Management System), and OMS (Order Management System), and utilizing Python and AI tools for automation development to support the operation and optimize the experience of teams such as Supplier Support, Customer Support, and Andon.
This is not just a "report-running" job. In the Customer-Centric Planning team, you will:
Delve into underlying technologies: Directly operate Airflow and Presto clusters, participating in the complete lifecycle from Raw Data to Insight.
Embrace new technologies: We actively introduce AI (Windsurf, Gemini, Copilot) and automation tools to eliminate repetitive tasks.
What You Will Do
Quickly support (within hours) and respond to the needs of various operational teams, formulate Ad-Hoc analysis plans, and produce high-quality, highly accurate data reports.
Operational Pain Point Analysis and Root Cause Analysis: Building a customer experience funnel, identifying process issues and operational problems from the user lifecycle, and analyzing deep-seated causes.
End-to-End Data Pipeline Construction and Maintenance (ETL & Pipeline): Using Presto/Hive SQL to process large-scale data, responsible for designing and maintaining Airflow DAGs, developing and optimizing Data Marts, monitoring data pipeline health, and ensuring data quality.
Process Automation and Tool Development (Automation & Tooling): Using Python to develop automation scripts, integrating Slack, GitHub, Zendesk, Tableau, Presto, Confluence, and various internal APIs, and using/introducing LangChain, MCP Server to achieve automated updates and releases for various research, report generation, Quality Assurance, etc., reducing manual intervention and improving team efficiency.
Basic Qualifications
3+ years of data analysis or data engineering experience, with the ability to handle complex SQL queries (Recursive CTE, Window Functions, JSON parsing).
Possess business analysis sensitivity, capable of transforming vague business problems (e.g., "Why are customer complaints increasing?") into concrete data analysis projects.
Familiar with Tableau Server, Power BI, or related report creation and operation.
Preferred Qualifications
Familiar with customer service and ticketing system operational data structures: experience in data analysis for similar systems such as customer service, e-commerce, and logistics.
Possess e-commerce or supply chain domain knowledge: understanding of e-commerce business models and logistics inventory logic.
Possess practical Python development skills, capable of writing automation scripts, handling API integration, or performing data transformation.
Familiar with Airflow or similar workflow scheduling tools, with practical experience in writing and maintaining DAGs.
Familiar with version control tools (GitHub/Git), accustomed to Pull Request (PR) review and collaboration processes.
AI/LLM application experience: experience using LangChain or internal AI tools to build auxiliary analysis agents or automated processes.

jobs.description: Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Security and Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses. The Security and Loss Prevention Specialist (SLP Specialist) is a key hourly position within Amazon Operations. The SLP Specialist leads the effort to efficiently and effectively protect people, product and data (lives, physical property, equipment, inventory, data, & intellectual property) in a designated building. The SLP Specialist reports to the Security and Loss Prevention Cluster Manager responsible for their geographical area, and aids them in supporting the operational team, and cross functional teams throughout the organization. Key job responsibilities · Conduct confidential investigations and prepare prompt written reports of theft, fraud, and critical incidents · Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement, data protection, physical security infrastructure) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards · Serve as department liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert for site leadership keeping them informed on key issues, strategies, and the department’s performance · Develop strategies for alarm reduction and conduct system diagnostic for problematic devices by engaging and resolving issues with internal and external partners · Domestic regional travel up to 25% of the time when applicable. · Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs). · This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays. A day in the life As a SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You will perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, and you contribute to developing mitigating measures to address them. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our fulfillment, logistics and retail operations locations by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems with subject matter experts and external suppliers to maintain their functionality. You will interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re seeking an experienced Facilities Operations Project Manager with a strong engineering background to lead mission-critical facilities work across our Southaven and Memphis sites. As a key on-site leader on the facilities operations team, you’ll bring technical credibility, engineering expertise, and steady project leadership to fast-paced, high-impact work in live, technically advanced facilities. You’ll own vendor and internal relationships, drive site improvement and activation projects from scope through handover, and keep operating systems reliable without taking the campus offline.

You will own the project portfolio that sits between those two: retrofits, upgrades, activations, vendor-led maintenance projects, and the facilities work that has to land cleanly into an operating plant. You’ll coordinate closely with facilities supervisors, technicians, construction, engineering, and commissioning, and report to facilities operations leadership.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Act as the facilities operations project representative for the Southaven and Memphis sites, managing relationships with contractors, vendors, partners, and internal stakeholders.
• Oversee end-to-end execution of facilities operations projects, from scoping and planning through installation, commissioning, and handover into day-to-day operations.
• Develop, plan, and execute site improvement, retrofit, and activation projects in accordance with overall business objectives and strategy, including mechanical/HVAC, electrical, compressed air, plumbing, and related campus systems.
• Coordinate multiple vendors and trade partners, ensuring seamless communication between field teams, facilities supervisors, technicians, engineering disciplines, and technical stakeholders.
• Proactively identify and mitigate risks to ensure high-quality delivery, safety, schedule adherence, and operational readiness on a live campus.
• Drive project progress, resolving roadblocks and keeping complex, multi-phase timelines on track while minimizing disruption to ongoing operations.
• Create and align facilities project schedules and deliverables with SpaceXAI’s broader infrastructure and AI supercomputing goals through cross-functional collaboration.
• Partner with construction, engineering, and commissioning teams to take work from build into operations and to resolve technical issues efficiently.
• Deliver regular updates using well-designed KPIs, dashboards, and reports for internal and external stakeholders.
• Perform quantity take-offs, field verifications, and progress monitoring to support accurate forecasting and reporting.
• Manage change orders, identifying value-engineered solutions to minimize unnecessary changes and control costs.
• Manage vendor and contractor finances; work with SpaceXAI buyers and accounts payable to assure accounts are maintained.
• Lead site safety initiatives on facilities project work, knowing and applying SpaceXAI safety procedures, observing contractor work, and allowing no work to be performed when conditions are considered unsafe.
• Know and understand mechanical and facilities equipment such as chilled water systems, boilers, VFDs, pumps, PLCs, condensers, split systems, air compressors, dust collectors, backflow preventers, and related systems in order to scope, sequence, and accept project work.
• Adapt to evolving needs, supporting cross-functional partners as required, regardless of original job scope

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree
• 5+ years of experience managing facilities operations or infrastructure projects.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Demonstrated success leading on-site project teams with authority and building trust with vendors, partners, and technical stakeholders.
• Experience managing programs involving multiple vendors, dynamic priorities, and complex coordination in an operating facility.
• Previous experience in data center, hyperscale, or industrial facilities operations (not greenfield construction as the primary background).
• Knowledge of building management and automated facilities monitoring systems and processes such as HVAC systems, fluid plumbing systems, generators, compressed air systems, or fuel storage systems.
• Experience with commissioning, MEP systems, or site development for technical facilities.
• Experience managing budgets and third-party vendors; experience negotiating contracts and comparing service costs to achieve maximum value.
• Experience with asset management / CMMS software and construction or project management tools (Procore, Primavera P6, Bluebeam, etc.).
• Proficiency in Microsoft applications such as Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Ability to work independently with little direction, meet deadlines in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment, and anticipate needs with innovative solutions for continuous improvement.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Based at the Memphis / Southaven sites.
• Position is subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing.
• Comfortable working in an environment requiring exposure to noise, operating equipment, and construction or maintenance activity.
• Available to work evenings and weekends, as the schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility is required.
• Ability to provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies and critical facility issues as assigned.
• Ability to lift 25+ pounds.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는
여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
조직소개
쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.
직무 소개
쿠팡이츠 Catalog Programs & Content 팀은 단순 일회성 프로젝트 수행을 넘어, 카탈로그 개선이라는 영역에 명확한 오너십을 가지고 다양한 이니셔티브를 주도적으로 발굴 및 추진하는 조직입니다. 데이터 기반의 카탈로그 개선점 발굴부터 머천트 안내 콘텐츠까지, 쿠팡이츠의 핵심 자산을 지속적으로 고도화하여 고객에게 최상의 탐색 경험을 제공합니다.

Director, Technical Program Management & Engineering Business Operations

San Mateo, CA (Hybrid)

Sony Interactive Entertainment is seeking a Director of Technical Program Management & Engineering Business Operations to lead the Technical Program Management function within Foundational Systems & Experiences Engineering (FSEE) while serving as a strategic partner to executive leadership.

This role combines leadership of the FSEE TPM organization in the Americas with responsibility for Engineering Business Operations in support of the VP's organization. The Director will lead and grow a team of Technical Program Managers driving execution across FSEE while partnering closely with executive leadership on organizational planning, strategic initiatives, communications, and operational excellence across a globally distributed organization.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering and serve as a member of their Engineering Leadership Team, acting as a trusted advisor on organizational strategy, planning, and execution. You will help shape the direction of the organization, drive alignment across their leadership teams, and ensure strategic priorities are translated into measurable outcomes.

This is a hybrid role based in San Mateo, California. Occasional international travel is expected to support our globally distributed teams.

Responsibilities

Technical Program Management Leadership

• Lead, mentor, and grow the Americas-based FSEE TPM team, building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Establish the operating models, delivery standards, governance, and reporting mechanisms that make complex cross-functional programs predictable and transparent.
• Partner with engineering, product, architecture, and operations leaders to drive successful execution of strategic initiatives across FSEE.
• Collaborate closely with TPM leadership in EMEA to establish consistent practices, operating mechanisms, and execution standards across regions.
• Develop talent, succession plans, and career paths across the TPM organization.
• Serve as the functional leader for Technical Program Management, ensuring the organization has the capabilities, operating mechanisms, and talent required to support current and future business priorities.

Engineering Business Operations

• Partner directly with the VP and Engineering Leadership Team to drive organizational priorities and long-term strategic objectives.
• Own annual planning, quarterly business reviews, goal setting, and leadership operating cadences across the regional engineering organization.
• Own executive communications and the narrative for leadership reviews, strategic updates, and organizational reporting for the regional VP.
• Drive operational excellence through the establishment of metrics, dashboards, and KPIs that provide leadership with visibility into organizational health and performance.
• Partner with the VP on organizational design, workforce planning, budget management, and investment prioritization.
• Surface organizational risks, opportunities, execution gaps, and develop plans to address them.
• Improve organizational effectiveness through scalable operating mechanisms, decision-making frameworks, and continuous improvement.

Strategic Execution & Executive Partnership

• Serve as a member of the VPs Engineering Leadership Team and act as a trusted advisor on organizational strategy, planning, and execution.
• Facilitate executive decision-making through clear analysis, structured problem solving, and concise communication.
• Drive accountability on leadership commitments, turning strategic priorities into measurable outcomes.

Required Qualifications

• 12+ years of experience leading complex technical programs within software, platform, infrastructure, cloud, or related engineering organizations.
